item.title: NT Daily 11/12: Christmas Parade Livestream, Holiday Mart & Your Thanksgiving Recipes | Jefferson City News-Tribune
item.description:
On today's NT Daily, Erin Schrimpf and Amanda Riley team up to talk about what's coming up around Jefferson City, starting with news that the News Tribune will livestream this year's Christmas parade on Saturday, Dec. 5.
Also today: Holiday Mart Jefferson City is tonight, with proceeds from ticket sales and vendor booth fees benefiting Project Pinwheel, a local nonprofit that supports families facing medical hardship. Little Explorers Discovery Center hosts its princess party fundraiser Saturday with sessions at 10 a.m. and 1 p.m. Plus, a heads-up on Missouri River bridge delays, a flu shot reminder and a look at this weekend's district football and soccer playoffs.
We're collecting your Thanksgiving recipes, from family favorites to allergy-friendly dishes to the occasional kitchen fail. Watch for the recipe page at newstribune.com.
Have an event or news to share? Email nt@newstribune.com or call 761-0240.

item.title: Inside the numbers: Blowouts are common, close games rare so far in this NBA season
item.description: The NBA is seeing an unprecedented number of blowouts this season, with an average winning margin of 13.8 points per game. This is the most lopsided start in league history.
